scripts.build: cd frontend-react && npm run build && cd .. && npx prisma generate --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:status: npx prisma migrate status --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma --config backend/prisma/prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema backend/prisma/schema.prisma --config backend/prisma/prisma.config.ts
